kind: research supplementary data and simple agent example

runtime.execution: A minimal synchronous OpenAI text-command loop with injected callable tools; accompanying chemistry CSV artifacts.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns in-memory history and example callable dispatch only; full experimental robotics/search system from the article is not this simple implementation.

summary: Public supporting data plus a toy command-routing implementation; CALCULATE/RANDOM/STOP are the actually shipped example tools.

inspection.scope: entire simple_implementation loop/tool bodies/launch composition and repository scope README
inspection.limits: No full research system or first-party test suite exists in inspected inventory. No code/chemistry actions/providers executed; paper results are not runtime conformance proof.

actions.name: Coscientist.run / get_next_message
actions.input: Prompt,max_steps, injected command_name/callable/prompt objects and config model.
actions.output: Mutated history/log messages; no returned durable run handle.
actions.authority: Host chooses callable dictionary; provider authority external.

actions.name: CALCULATE / RANDOM / STOP
actions.input: Python expression; two integer bounds; ignored STOP input.
actions.output: Expression result/error string; random integer; termination exception.
actions.lifecycle: One command-leading line per text reply; literal substring count feedback.
actions.authority: Host eval authority unrestricted; no actual chemistry/robot tool is supplied.

filesystem.detail: No native filesystem tool; eval can call arbitrary Python expression with host/module authority. That generic escape capability is not a designed file operation contract.

processes.detail: No process/job API; unrestricted expression evaluation can invoke imported/host operations when composed. No lifetime/interrupt/quiescence semantics supplied.

code_actions.detail: CALCULATE directly evals arbitrary expression; no cell/kernel/schema or incremental source-edit mechanism. Count-by-substring routing can misclassify incidental command text.

evidence.claim: Repository labels itself supporting information with chemistry data and a simple implementation; not the full apparatus.
Injected callable tools generate prompt descriptions, model receives in-memory message history and model text is logged/appended.
Substring tool counts enforce zero/one/many feedback; first command-leading line dispatches one string argument and output becomes user message; StopIteration terminates.
CALCULATE uses unconstrained eval returning str/result or exception; RANDOM parses two integers; STOP raises custom StopIteration.
Shipped example only composes CALCULATE/RANDOM/STOP with fixed gpt-4-0314 and ten-step limit.

strengths: Very small inspectable example of tools described by objects and sequential feedback.
limits: Full experimental Coscientist implementation cannot be inferred from toy example/data.
Substring command detection and unrestricted eval have no robust action/authority lifecycle.
arconaut_questions: How can flexible operator-injected actions carry typed identity/lifetime without relying on incidental text matching?
